title: A Phone Call to Cancel an Appointment
summary: Llamada telefónica — pasado, disculpas, reprogramar. Registro cortés.
script:
Receptionist: Good afternoon, Dr. Lopez's office. How can I help you?
Caller: Hello. I have an appointment tomorrow at four, but I can't come.
Receptionist: I see. Can I take your name, please?
Caller: Yes, it's Marta Ruiz.
Receptionist: Thank you. Would you like to cancel or reschedule?
Caller: I'd like to reschedule, if possible. I'm sorry for the short notice.
Receptionist: That's no problem. We have Thursday at eleven, or Friday afternoon.
Caller: Thursday at eleven works better for me.
Receptionist: Perfect. I've moved your appointment to Thursday at eleven.
Caller: Thank you so much. Have a nice day.
